acceptanceCriteria.text: `publish.yml`'s `publish` job (or a job it `needs:`) either runs `test:integration` and `test:e2e` directly against the exact revision being published, or consumes a verified, non-stale required-check result for that exact SHA from `ci.yml`.
A deliberately-injected regression that passes fast/smoke but fails integration or e2e is proven, by test or dry-run, to block npm publication.

The `environment: npm` protection rule's actual configuration (required reviewers, wait timer) is documented in this Issue's resolution once inspected in repository settings, since it cannot be verified from workflow source alone.

issue.title: fix: gate npm publish on exact-SHA integration/e2e certification
